{{Quote|Our facility, and all of the mines of Tilnes, are in jeopardy because a certain other group has also chosen to establish a base of operations in within Tilnes. Unlike ourselves, however, they did not first enter into a legitimate business arrangement with the kind folk of Verga Mer Mining Company.|Thurm Loogg, on the Thaereian military's establishment of a base on Tilnes|<ref name="Tilnes Rising" />}}
During the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Thaereian military]], an [[Army/Legends|armed force]] [[Thaereian Navy charter|chartered]] to defend the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], operated a secret '''base''' on [[Tilnes]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Tilnes]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. Circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] ventured close to the base and were ambushed by [[Thaereian]] troops. With their presence on Tilnes discovered, the Thaereian military subsequently abandoned the base.
 
==Description==
{{Quote|The fact that the piggies and the Thaereians were so close to the Smile really sits badly for me. I mean, it makes a lot of sense that they'd use that area as a cover, but it also tells me that they didn't care, and when you flaunt not caring around things like that, they come back to bite you.|HB7, on the proximity of the Thaereian military and Metatheran Cartel bases on Tilnes to Kaernor's Smile|<ref name="Tilnes Falling">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20030306scenario|text=Tilnes Falling|int=Tilnes Falling}}</ref>}}
The [[Thaereian military]] base on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Tilnes]] was situated deep beneath the surface of the world,<ref name="Tilnes Rising" /> near to [[Kaernor's Smile]],<ref name="Tilnes Falling" /> a vast chasm with a mysterious reputation.<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> A [[Verga Mer Mining Company]] employee going by the moniker [[HB7]] later speculated that the Thaereian outpost derived cover from its proximity to the Smile.<ref name="Tilnes Falling" /> The base had capacity for [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] to land.<ref name="Tilnes Rising" />
 
==History==
{{Quote|After being assigned to a secret base beneath Tilnes&mdash;a base which, by his estimation, had no reason to be secret as it lay within the bounds of Cularin&mdash;and learning that the Thaereian forces had some sort of alliance with the Metatheran Cartel (whom Dal'Nay had long distrusted), he became convinced that drastic action might need to be taken.|Yara Grugara, interviewing Osten Dal'Nay|<ref name="Osten Dal'Nay">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/lf20050721ostendalnay|text=Osten Dal'Nay|int=Osten Dal'Nay (article)}}</ref>}}
During the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Thaereian military,<ref name="Tilnes Rising" /> an [[Army/Legends|armed force]] [[Thaereian Navy charter|mandated]] by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] to defend the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]],<ref name="Over Thaere">{{Wizards|url=rpga/livingforce/article.asp?x=lf/swlf20011004b_thaere&c=swlfc|text=Over Thaere|int=Over Thaere}}</ref> operated a base on Tilnes, a moon of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. The Thaereians established the base without consent from the Verga Mer Mining Company,<ref name="Tilnes Rising" /> a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] firm with rights to extract Tilnes' [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] deposits,<ref name="LFCG" /> and the existence of the installation was kept secret. The [[Metatheran Cartel]] trading concern independently setup a [[Metatheran Cartel Tilnes base|base]] on Tilnes and considered the presence of the Thaereian facility to be disruptive to their own operation. Nevertheless, the Cartel took care not to interfere with the Thaereian base.<ref name="Tilnes Rising" />
 
The Thaereian military [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]]<ref name="Osten Dal'Nay" /> [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]]<ref name="Tilnes Rising" /> [[Osten Dal'Nay]] came to be stationed at the Thaereian military Tilnes base.<ref name="Osten Dal'Nay" /> Dal'Nay became increasingly disillusioned with the Thaereian military and believed there was no justification for the Thaereians to be concealing the existence of the Tilnes base since their operation there was within their remit to defend Cularin.<ref name="Osten Dal'Nay" /> Circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]],<ref name="Dates">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. ''[[Broken Orbits: Tilnes Rising]]'' can hence be dated to circa 31 BBY. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], ''[[Tilnes Falling]]'' can therefore be dated to circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]</ref> the [[heroes of Cularin]], a group of<ref name="Tilnes Rising" /> Culariner<ref name="Osten Dal'Nay" /> freelance agents investigating crystal mine collapses on Tilnes, ventured close to the Cartel<ref name="Tilnes Rising" /> and Thaereian military secret bases.<ref name="Osten Dal'Nay" /> After the agents encountered Cartel personnel beneath Tilnes, the Cartel representative [[Thurm Loogg]] tried to deflect the freelancers' attention away from the Cartel base by recommending that they investigate the Thaereian military base instead. Loogg further claimed that the Thaereian presence on Tilnes placed all of the moon's subterranean mines at risk from materials knocked out from [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] by capital [[Starship/Legends|ships]] landing at the Thaereian base.<ref name="Tilnes Rising" />
 
The heroes of Cularin pressed on towards the Thaereian military base<ref name="Tilnes Rising" /> and troops at the outpost received an order from high up in the Thaereian military chain of command to neutralize the Culariners.<ref name="Osten Dal'Nay" /> Learning that the Thaereians were staging an ambush and concerned that the Thaereian military were behaving detrimentally to the people of Cularin, Dal'Nay deserted and helped the heroes of Cularin to escape.<ref name="Tilnes Rising" /> Following the discovery of their presence on Tilnes, the Thaereian military abandoned the base.<ref name="Caaried Away">{{LivingForce|Metatheran Caution: Caaried Away}}</ref>
 
Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Dates" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], in an internal memo sent to Verga Mer Mining Company managers the individual HB7 criticized the Thaereian military for setting up their base so close to Kaernor's Smile. HB7 believed this evidenced a disregard of local myths regarding the chasm. Later during the Clone Wars, the broadcaster [[Yara Grugara]] referenced the Thaereian base in a media interview with Osten Dal'Nay, in which she described the circumstances of Dal'Nay's desertion from the Thaereian installation.<ref name="Osten Dal'Nay" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Thaereian military base on Tilnes was first mentioned in ''[[Broken Orbits: Tilnes Rising]]'', a [[2001]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure written by [[Morrie Mullins (real person)|Morrie Mullins]]. The adventure formed part of the [[Broken Orbits trilogy]] of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign,<ref name="Tilnes Rising" /> an [[RPGA]] roleplaying series for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="LFCG" /> The base was later referenced in the [[2003]] ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Metatheran Caution: Caaried Away]]''<ref name="Caaried Away" /> and in the [[Wizards.com]] ''Living Force'' tie-in articles ''[[Tilnes Falling]]'' and ''[[Osten Dal'Nay (article)|Osten Dal'Nay]]'',<ref name="Osten Dal'Nay" /> also all written by Morrie Mullins.<ref name="Caaried Away" /><ref name="Tilnes Falling" /><ref name="Osten Dal'Nay" />
